scope: saved evidence only; no benchmarks, compilers, or native workloads rerun
statistical_method: Exact Fraction interpolation of sorted integer ns at p*(n-1), inclusive Q1/median/Q3; ratios of engine medians. IQR overlap is descriptive, not a significance test.

comparison_families.application: Rewritten application on current Imre and CPython; preserved old application on baseline Imre. Changes combine source and compiler/runtime effects.
comparison_families.common-source: Exact old application on current Imre, preserved Imre, and CPython. Current-versus-preserved Imre holds application source fixed.

cross_family_caveat: Families are sequential measurement batches; direct cross-family source-effect ratios are not paired or causal estimates.
